title: sorbus umbellata var. cretica
intro: Sorbus umbellata var. cretica, commonly known as the Mountain Ash, is a deciduous shrub or small tree that belongs to the Rosaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues due to its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Sorbus umbellata var. cretica include soothing digestive issues, reducing fever, and alleviating respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
